AssignAccountsToProfileRequest.description: You cannot provide non-empty accountIds and set assignToAllAccounts to true at the same time.

account_ids.description: List of account IDs to assign

notification.description: Notification email address for account-related alerts

language.description: Account language name (e.g. polish, dutch, english)

products.description: Product configuration. Array must be non-empty.

profile.description: Billing profile identifier. Go to update card/billing settings, copy the string_id from the URL.

country.description: ISO country code (e.g. US, PL, GB)

snapshot_id.description: ID of the snapshot to clone from. Obtain from GET /api/child-account-snapshots/v1/ endpoint.

description.example: Product knowledge base for AI context

status.description: Snapshot status from the external AM2 system.

creation_status.description: Internal snapshot creation status stored in our system. Possible values from CreateSnapshotStatusEnum. Fallbacks to "unknown" when no status is found.

created_at.description: When the snapshot was created. ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00).

completed_at.description: When the snapshot was completed. ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00). Null when not yet completed.

snapshots.description: List of account snapshots for the reseller.

next_cursor.description: Next cursor token. Use it as query parameter as ?next_cursor=<cursor>.

accounts.description: List of accounts available for snapshots.

languages.description: Supported language catalog. Keys are the values to send back on writes (e.g. "english", "german"); values are display labels.

timezones.description: Supported timezone catalog. Keys are the IANA identifiers to send back on writes (e.g. "America/Chicago"); values are display labels.
